name: Yamaha V Star 950
engine: 942 cc air-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: A mid-size fuel-injected Star cruiser. Some 2009-2012 bikes are in a fuel pipe recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2009-2012 V Star 950s are in recall 11V533 because the fuel delivery pipe may leak.
A-002.reason: A fuel leak near a hot engine is a fire risk. The fix is free.

recalls.what: The fuel delivery pipe may not seal and can leak fuel.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel delivery pipe free.
